name: 5+1 Context, Frequency-Ordered WordNet Glosses
description: English fine-grained WSD prompt using the target sentence with 5 preceding and 1 following sentence, <t>...</t> target marking, WordNet sense keys, definitions, synonyms, and usage examples. Candidate senses are ordered by WordNet frequency; the model returns JSON with sense_index.

messages.content: You are an English linguist performing fine-grained Word Sense Disambiguation. WordNet glosses are schematic. Use the sentence context, the examples, and the synonyms to choose the best indexed sense. Do not hedge. Choose the single best indexed sense.
